summary.text: Named among the fifty-seven suitors from Dulichium in Apollodorus' catalogue — a homonym of Thrasymedes son of Nestor at sandy Pylos.

story.text: Apollodorus names Thrasymedes among the wooers who came from Dulichium, listed after Megasthenes and before Ormenius in Epitome 7.27. Homer and Apollodorus elsewhere know Thrasymedes as a son of Nestor (Odyssey 3.405–445; Bibliotheca 1.9.9) — not this Dulichian suitor.
